name: Bob Khalsa
office: City of Santa Clarita, Member of the City Council, 5th District

items.text: Bob Khalsa is a business owner, former fighter and commercial airline pilot, and high school science teacher. He is the president of United America Realty Services Inc. He served as president of the Santa Clarita Division of the Southland Regional Association of Realtors in 2013 and 2015, and as a board member of the California Association of Realtors. His campaign says he would focus on public safety and carefully planned growth that protects the character of local neighborhoods without increasing traffic or straining city services. He supports effective law enforcement partnerships, crime prevention, and emergency preparedness.
